info.title: Yandere Dark Elf: She Chased Me All the Way From Another World!
info.synopsis: Hinata ce l'ha fatta. Si è reincarnato in un altro mondo, ha assunto il ruolo di Eroe e infine ha ucciso il Signore dei Demoni con l'aiuto dei suoi compagni avventurieri. Come ricompensa, è tornato sulla Terra per vivere la sua vita da normale liceale giapponese... o sarebbe così se Mariabelle, un'elfa oscura che è stata la sua prima compagna e più fervente sostenitrice durante la sua avventura, non l'avesse seguito proclamando che sono destinati a stare insieme per sempre. Ora Hinata dovrà gestire la sua vita scolastica con la costante presenza dell'elfa dall'amore tanto passionale quanto ossessivo, mentre Mariabelle utilizza le sue arti arcane per allontanare qualsiasi potenziale rivale d'amore e catturare l'affetto del ragazzo!

info.title: RG Veda (ITA)
info.synopsis:
Il primo episodio, Castle of Ice, Prison of Flame, fu pubblicato nel giugno 1991 e traspone, adattandolo liberamente, il capitolo L'inferno del castello di ghiaccio (Suijou engoku hen), pubblicato nel quarto volume della serie, in cui Yasha-o, tornato nel luogo in cui un tempo sorgeva il villaggio della sua tribù, viene imprigionato da un demone con le sembianze di una dolce principessa.
Il secondo, Castle of Fire and Lightning, fu pubblicato nel giugno 1992 e, mischiando tra loro vari eventi del manga con altri creati appositamente per l'anime, propone una vicenda del tutto inedita, temporalmente parallela agli ultimi volumi del manga. Dopo un breve prologo in cui assistiamo alla battaglia di 300 anni prima tra Taishakuten e Ashura-o, il gruppo di Yasha-o e Ashura irrompe nel castello dell'imperatore e ingaggia battaglia coi suoi generali; l'episodio si conclude con un finale aperto.

info.title: The Big O
info.synopsis: Sono trascorsi 40 anni da un incidente denominato "The Event", che distrusse la città di Paradigm e cancellò la memoria dei suoi cittadini. Anche se le loro vite tornano alla normalità, attraverso l'uso della tecnologia come l'elettricità o i veicoli, sono ancora afflitti dal problema di non sapere cosa sia successo esattamente loro oltre 40 anni fa. Roger Smith, il protagonista della storia, tiene al sicuro Paradigm City con l'aiuto di The Big O (un robot gigante molto potente), il suo fedele maggiordomo Norman e l'androide Dorothy. Man mano che i problemi aumentano e i ricordi emergono, il passato di Roger e il futuro di Paradigm iniziano a diventare sempre più sospetti...

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: In the pilot episode, Roger Smith is introduced as Paradigm City's top negotiator.  As the episode begins, he is delivering the ransom for a girl named Dorothy, who had been kidnapped from her father, a rich industrialist named Saldano.  After the exchange, Saldano arrives and reveals that the Dorothy Roger they had obtained was actually an android fake.  When Roger realizes Beck isn't playing fair, he activates the briefcase carrying the ransom and it flies out of Beck's car.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: In the previous episode, Major Dastun and Dorothy looked like they were going to be crushed by Dorothy One as it fell.  However, when the dust cleared, Dastun was fine and Dorothy had disappeared.  Roger took Big O back into the subway to escape Dastun's rage over the destruction of the fight.  Then, he began to search for Dorothy.  He received a tip about a nightingale in the city, which led him to a club called Nightingale.  There Roger found Dorothy along with a man named Waynewright who said he was her grandfather.  Dorothy sang in the club after which Beck arrived, shot Waynewright, knocked out Roger and kidnapped Dorothy.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Recently, there's been a number of power outages in Paradigm. Roger is hired by Paradigm Power Management to go to the Electric City and negotiate with the locals the reactivation of the hydroelectric power plant. They say a god lives in the water.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: A woman named Patricia Lovejoy (the same woman called Angel in Electric City) approaches Roger Smith about a job with Paradigm.  He is supposed to convince a reporter named Michael Seebach to hand over his manuscript, but as it turns out, Seebach had disappeared months earlier.  Using his connections with Major Dastun, Roger tracks down an apartment Seebach is renting.  There he discovers a typewriter and a large stack of papers, which he begins to read when gasoline pours in under the door and lights.  Roger jumps out the window to escape and is confronted by Seebach, now calling himself Schwartzvald and wrapped in bandages.  Seebach tells Roger to report to Paradigm that they will never see him in the city again, then disappears.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: A military police vehicle crashes after seeing an apparition while crossing a certain bridge and it is apparently only the latest in a string of such accidents involving high ups in the military police.  Roger is retained to work for a billionaire named Melissa Frazier who wants Roger to find her son Bonny.  Bonny worked for the military police and was killed during a riot on the haunted bridge a year earlier, after which time the ghost sightings began.  His body fell into the water and disappeared.  Roger is tipped that Bonny may have been killed because he was going to reveal corruption in the MPs.   He goes to track down one of the few remaining conspirators, a Colonel Gaust, but he has been taken to the bridge by Bonny Frazier and pushed into the water.  Both Big O and Dastun attempt to attack the apparition, but their attacks appear to go through it, while it's missiles assault Big O from all directions. episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: After waking Roger up with her piano playing, Roger decides to take Dorothy to see a friend who can help her learn to add feeling to her playing.  His friend is a robot named Instro, who was built by a scientist named Amadeus and thought of Instro as a son.  Instro remembers how happy Amadeus was when Instro would play the piano for him.  While Instro is giving Dorothy a lesson, a mysterious stranger arrives and reminds Instro that he needs to fulfill his creator's legacy.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Episode begins, Roger and Angel are trapped in a building buried under the sea, one of a string apparently created by the Event.  Three days earlier, Roger is trying to negotiate to bring down the price of fish for the people outside the domes.  He learns that the reason fish is so expensive is because the fishermen won't go out to fish because they are scared of a sea titan in the water.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Dorothy befriends a stray cat and takes it in. Roger thinks it's cute until the owners of the cat show up. But what's more, the cat is more than what he seems to be.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Episode begins with Beck being broken out of prison by a Megadeus.  Then, Roger is hired by Mr. Wise, a rich industrialist, to negotiate for the return of his kidnapped son, Francis.  After hanging up on the kidnappers, Roger is fired by Wise, only to be rehired when the ransom is paid and his son is not returned.  The kidnappers call back, recognize Roger's voice and agree to return the son if Roger brings the ransom.  Roger finds Francis at the cabin he was directed to, but the police arrive believing that Roger was the kidnapper.  This was a setup by the real kidnapper, Beck, to get revenge on Roger (see Roger The Negotiator and Dorothy Dorothy).

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Major Dastun has been having a recurring dream about a woman in white who is shot on a pier with her final words being ""Vous Ãªtes si gentil.""  The language has been long forgotten in Paradigm City, but it still seems familiar.  At the same time, a toy robot crawls into a packed church and explodes.  It is the latest in attacks by terrorists who are targeting retired city officials.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Dorothy is buying a tie for Roger at the department store in preparation for Heaven's Day.  Roger snaps at her when he sees her and when he apologizes, he sees a saxophone player on the sidewalk whom he gives to generously.  Later, at Roger's house, Norman explains Heaven's Day to Dorothy, one of the traditions being to give presents to those you love.  When Dorothy asks Roger if he would be giving gifts to anyone, he becomes nervous and declares that he doesn't like the gift-giving.  This causes Dorothy to storm out of the room.   The saxophone player, Oliver, brings home some ham with the money Roger gave him and tells his blind girlfriend Laura that he would like to give her a good Heaven's Day gift.  Roger consults Norman on Dorothy's reactions and Norman tells him that Dorothy's birthday is apparently on Heaven's Day. episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Roger is hired by Alex Rosewater to deliver a very large severance check to Michael Seebach aka Schwartzvald.  After accepting the assignment, Roger intercepts the police radio about a new Megadeus which has appeared at JFK Mark.  He goes there as Big O and is confronted by a Megadeus swaddled in bandages and controlled by Schwartzvald.  The Megadei begin to battle with Schwartzvald's Megadeus wrapping Big O in his bandages.  Roger fights back, burning away the bandages to reveal another Big O unharmed.  The robot then vanishes, leaving only a bandage to fall from the sky.   Back at his house, Angel calls Roger to give him Schwartzvald's whereabouts.  Roger follows the directions to find that Schwartzvald is throwing a masquerade party.  Roger talks to Schwartzvald, who is dressed as a clown, and who uses the partygoers as an example of the corruption of the city. episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: The episode begins with a mysterious woman in a red cloak and hood murdering several people, leaving behind only the phrase, ""Cast In The Name Of Good  Ye Not Guilty.""  This is the phrase shown on Big O when activated.  One of the dead is a dancer named Ellen Weight, a client of Roger's who had memories from before the Event, despite being far too young.

info.title: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
info.synopsis: "Sono venuta per mangiarti". Queste sono le parole che pronuncia dolcemente la sirena Shiori mentre emerge dall'acqua e prende per mano la studentessa delle superiori Hinako. La ragazza vive da sola in una città vicino al mare ed il suo corpo insolitamente delizioso risulta irresistibile per qualsiasi mostro nelle vicinanze. Per assicurarsi che maturi nelle migliori condizioni, Shiori cerca di proteggerla, affinchè un giorno possa divorare ogni pezzo di lei. Che ne sarà dei sentimenti di Hinako che, dopo un passato tragico, si ritrova davanti ad una morte tanto ingiusta quanto incombente?

episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne finally gets fed up with Wilfried's complaints and offers to switch spots with him for a day.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: 収穫祭。今年は各地を巡りつつ、ローゼマインの薬の素材「リュエルの実」の採集も行う。神官長・フェルディナンドに代わって、ローゼマインの兄・エックハルト、そしてリヒャルダの息子・ユストクスが同行することに。なんでもユストクスは情報集めが大好きな変人で、彼によると魔力の高まるシュツェーリアの夜が採集に最適な日らしい。そしてやってきた採集の日。リュエルの実の元へ向かう一同だが――そこに強大な魔獣が現れる！

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: To improve the printing press, Ingo is even willing to exchange ideas between different trades.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: The winter social season is here and Rosemyne must successfully finish her debut.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne attempts to gather materials for her jureve once again!

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: Hasse's punishment has finally been decided and Rosemyne must go to witness the results.

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne must go to the Goddess's Bath on the Night of Fruhtrane to collect the spring material for her jureve.

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: Brigitte tries on the dress that Rosemyne designed while the printing press is finally ready for a test print.

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: With the archduke and his wife away, Rozemyne must stay at the castle with Wilfried.

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: The Star-Binding Ceremony begins and Rosemyne hopes Brigitte's new dress will enchant the nobility.

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne and her Gutenberg go to Illgner in hopes of finding new materials for papermaking.

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: Georgine comes to visit and everyone in Ehrenfest question her true motives.

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne tries to gather the ruelle fruit once again. This time Ferdinand and Karstedt join to ensure success.

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: Rosemyne discovers Wilfried's actions and a meeting is convened to determine the truth of the matter.

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: Charlotte is officially welcomed to the Archduke's family, but there is danger lurking in the shadows.

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: 襲撃者に捕らわれたローゼマインだが、孫娘の危機に奮起したボニファティウスに助け出される。しかし体を蝕む毒は深刻で、急遽フェルディナンドはユレーヴェを使う。長い眠りにつくローゼマイン。命だけでも助かったことを安堵する下町家族。ローゼマインのいない日常で、ヴィルフリートとシャルロッテは代わりに神事を、下町の仲間や神殿の側仕えは本作りを、フェルディナンドはその傍らで目覚めの時を待ち続ける。そして――。

info.title: Dragon Girl Problem
info.synopsis: In quanto figlia del Re Drago, Kim Yong Man non ha mai avuto una vera indipendenza. Quando suo padre cerca di costringerla a sposarsi, Yong Man decide di scappare di casa per vivere finalmente una vita "normale". Si iscrive così a una scuola per umani e giura di diventare la studentessa migliore dell'istituto. Tuttavia, a Shim Hae Soo, lo studente con i voti più alti nell'intera scuola, non è affatto contento dell'arrivo di una nuova rivale e giura che non le permetterà mai di superarlo. Mentre Yong Man e Hae Soo continuano a sfidarsi a suon di voti e a concentrarsi nello studio, iniziano a farsi sempre più vicini. I loro duelli accademici finiranno per trasformarsi in qualcosa di più? E che conseguenze avrà tutto ciò per Yong Man e per il suo lato sovrannaturale? Questa serie animata è un adattamento dell'omonimo webcomic di Olso.

info.title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
info.synopsis: Special realizzato per commemorare il 30° anniversario della prima messa in onda della serie anime. Mentre il Giappone è in fibrillazione per l'emissione della nuova banconota da 10.000 yen che celebra il celebre design della Torre Touto, Conan, i giovani detective, il professor Agasa, Ran e Sonoko si recano in visita allo stabilimento di Nagano dell'ufficio stampa della Banca del Giappone.Nel frattempo, a Tokyo, la scoperta di denaro contraffatto sulla scena di un omicidio spinge il Dipartimento della Polizia Metropolitana ad aprire un'indagine ufficiale. L'inedita e massiccia circolazione di false banconote getta il Paese nel caos, spingendo Conan e Heiji a partire alla volta di Osaka, ritenuta il covo in cui il denaro falso è stato stampato.
